strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
...Well, I'll be... Is this... New York?
Looking for Show, I end up in a place like this... And it's all since...
these things showed up... The Aura Road opened... Could it be...
An Aura Battler after all! What's going on?
Is the Aura Road opening more easily now!?
Show, look!
...SHALL... COME...
Not an Aura Battler...? What is that... Cham?
This is... Cham!?
It's them! The friends of those bony things!
Whatever they want... if they're in our way, we smash through...!
(That voice... again...!?
And this time... nobody else can hear their voices...!?)
What!? Seriously, what the hell!
How many armies do we have to fight before this war ends!?
True... Zeon... Even the fighting between people of Earth
hasn't ended yet...!
What's going on? He called that an Aura Battler, didn't he?
It looks like they're helping it, too.
Tetsuya, you think so too...?
That's... the Dunbine! Show! So this is where you were!
Wha-- Todd!? You came up to the surface too!
Todd Guinness!? That man's on the surface too!?
What has become of Byston Well!?
Who cares why we came out here?
I'm gonna settle things with you, Show!
Come on! Do you even get what's going on!? This is no time to fight...
Quit your yapping! Show, here I come...!
Ngh, Todd...!
What the hell are they fussing about! Just take him out!
Big Bro! Brute force isn't always the answer.
Right! ...Though it looks like we've got no choice but to fight.
All units, launch!
...Todd... I want to get through this without killing you...
That's the one that showed up with those Death Army enemies, right?
What about Master, who's chasing the Death Army?
I've got a bad feeling about this... Let's go!
What? Surface reinforcements!?
Master!?
...Master, you came here chasing the Death Army too?
Amuro...
...Yeah. What is this...? This grating feeling...?
Master Asia's acting... strange somehow...
What are you saying, Rain! Ugh...!?
Domon, your master's been surrounded!
Master, I'm coming!
...Hahaha.
Master?
Heheheheh... You fool! Have you still not realized who I truly am!?
Come forth, Death Army!
He called the enemy...!?
Wait, Master Asia!?
C-Could Master Asia have served the Devil Gundam from the start?
...That can't be... My master isn't that kind of man!
Domon... No wonder you're shocked. No wonder you can't believe it...
But this is the truth.
Are you sad, Domon? Are you afraid, Domon? Your master sees all.
So trust in me, and you shall be saved.
Wh-What is he saying? He betrays us, then tries to win him over?
I am always with you. So be at ease.
Look, the Devil Gundam... no, your brother awaits.
...My brother's waiting... Master is with me...
No, Domon!
His brother's waiting? ...What does that mean?
The one who stole the Devil Gundam that Domon's group is chasing...
is his own brother.
What did you say?
Then he joined the Gandor Team to defeat his brother?
Yes. Come with me... and grow strong, strong, strong... stronger...
Don't! It's hypnosis! Wake up, Domon!
Tch, what an annoying girl...
Domon, are you all right!?
Pull yourself together, Domon!
Domooon!
Shut up!
Too soft, Domon!
Your Shining Finger won't work on me!
The King of Hearts' master... Master Asia, the Undefeated of the East.
...With him as an enemy, this is trouble.
Todd and the others' Drake army...
and the Devil Gundam army, led by Master Asia...
A three-way battle... How do we get through this...
Master... I'll wake you up with my own hands.
Stop it! Todd!
What on earth is happening in Byston Well!?
Same mess as ever! But none of that matters!
You droopy-eyed jerk! We might never be able to go back!
I said I don't care!
Besides, my home is this world! Suits me just fine!
Cham! He's in no state to listen! Get back!
Geez!
Surface people like us shouldn't be doing this...
If only I get a chance to talk him down!
Pointless! Show Zama!
That's enough for today...
But Domon, the next time we meet, I will surely take your life.
...Prepare yourself and wait for me!
Wait, Master!
Why!? Tell me it's a bad joke! Masterrr!
Don't be a weakling, Domon! This is the truth! Plain, with no lie in it!
That's enough for today...
But Domon, the next time we meet, I will surely take your life.
...Prepare yourself and wait for me!
Wait, Master!
Why!? Tell me it's a bad joke! Masterrr!
Don't be a weakling, Domon! This is the truth! Plain, with no lie in it!
Master... Masteeerrr!
Master... Masteeerrr!
To think Master Asia was a servant of the Devil Gundam...
That's impossible! The Devil Gundam is just controlling Master!
Domon...
In the end... we never learned what the mystery enemies are...
And... the Aura Battlers and the mystery enemies... the Einst, was it?
I think that's what it was.
Their link to the Devil Gundam is unclear too... It's all too murky.
Captain Amuro, weren't those things... talking?
Talking...? No, I couldn't tell...
Come to think of it... that red robot from before didn't show up, huh?
Aren't the rest just AI or something?
(No... I definitely... heard it. That was the voice of a thinking being.)
Todd... why did we have to fight...
Show!? Look!
Hm... that's Todd!?
It wasn't a direct hit. He might still be alive, Show!
Commander Hazuki...!
...You may bring him aboard. I'll leave the rest to you... All right?
Thank you. The rest... I'll try to talk him around!
Either way, it seems all we can do is keep pushing forward.
The way might reveal itself in time.
Geez, how carefree.
Arguing here won't get us anywhere.
It's less a positive outlook than the only option, I'd say.
First bones, now plant-like things, huh.
Is there some connection, I wonder,
between all these invasions and those things showing up?
Who knows. ...But it's true they've been showing up more often lately...
For now, we head for Jaburo. Once all units are aboard, we depart at once.
